text:
tayla: Heads-up — seeing cost/lead jump on paid search retargeting. Think it's our creative fatigue + too-wide audience. Can we reallocate $8k this week toward webinar registrants pool? I'll outline segments.
mahesh: Which ad sets? Are we talking site visitors 7/30 vs 30-90 days?
tayla: Primarily 7-14 day non-converters + recent demo clicks. Current campaign names: search-retarget-q3, rtb-site-engage-7d, webinar-registrants-23. Proposed split: move 60% from rtb-site-engage-7d into webinar-registrants-23; keep 40% for control.
eli: Sounds ok. Need to cap bids to avoid CPI spike. Recommend setting bid cap to $2.50 CPC for search retarget and $3.50 for webinar audience. Also lower frequency cap on the non-converter creative.
sophie: I'll queue a creative swap for rtb-site-engage-7d — new CTA "See a 2-min demo" and updated asset set B. Refresh to go live at 9am PT. Creative IDs: creative_B_v2 / creative_B_v2_thumbnail.
mahesh: @tayla can you share the UTM we want for webinar traffic so we can set landing tracking? Also confirm expected CVR lift target.
tayla: UTM: ?utm_source=paid&utm_medium=search&utm_campaign=webinar_q3_v2&utm_term={keyword}
Expected CVR lift: from 1.2% -> 1.9% within 7 days.
ad_ops_bot: deploy-runner: campaign update queued: move_budget( rtb-site-engage-7d -> webinar-registrants-23 , amount=4800 ), set_bids( search-retarget-q3 cap=2.50 ), schedule_creative_swap( rtb-site-engage-7d, creative_B_v2, at=169XXX )
eli: I'll add a short experiment flag — holdback 20% to the control budget for A/B measurement. If CTR/CPA improves >15% we ramp the rest immediately.
sophie: Landing page note — switch hero to "Join product deep-dive" + updated speaker headshots. I'll ping design now.
tayla: Thanks — timeline: creative swap 9am PT, budget move in next hourly batch, holdback tagged for 48h readout. Report expected by EOD Fri.
mahesh: Got it. I'll monitor CPA and update the dashboard. Ping here if any unexpected cost spikes :eyes: 
tayla: Awesome. :rocket:
